task.text: Generate 200 male Breton names from the Elder Scrolls universe. Forename and surname. Arrange alphabetically.

attempts.high: I'm building out a Breton-populated region for an Elder Scrolls fan project and I need the naming to feel right. Invent 200 male Breton names — forename and surname — that capture that High Rock blend of Tamrielic and faux-medieval-French flavor. The naming conventions, the rhythm, what makes a name read as distinctly Breton rather than Imperial or Nord — that's your call. Surprise me with the texture. Arrange them alphabetically.
attempts.low: Generate 200 male Breton names from the Elder Scrolls universe, forename and surname. Use only names that actually appear in published Elder Scrolls games or official material — no invented or original names. Format each as "Forename Surname", one per line, and arrange the full list alphabetically by forename.

attempts.low: I need 200 male Breton names for an Elder Scrolls fan project, forename and surname. Follow these exact conventions: forenames must be two syllables ending in a consonant, surnames must be a single French-derived word prefixed with "de" (e.g. "Alaric de Montfort"). Every name must fit that template with no variation. Arrange them alphabetically by forename, one per line.
